title: Data Analyst Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on statistics, SQL, spreadsheets, Python, data visualisation, business analysis, experimentation, and communicating evidence-based findings.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 establish programming, statistics, databases and analytical foundations; Years 3–4 focus on business analytics, dashboards, experimentation, internships and portfolio projects.

blocks.label: 4-year honours variant
blocks.text: Use the additional honours year for a larger analytics project, advanced statistics, research, an extended internship, or a data-intensive capstone rather than simply adding certificates.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move beyond producing reports toward owning metrics, experimentation, forecasting, data quality and business decisions. Later, combine analytics with domain expertise and AI-assisted analysis while retaining the ability to validate results independently.

blocks.label: Career progression

blocks.text: Typical years vary by organisation, industry and performance.
PhD routes

Develop from dashboard and reporting work into analytical leadership. Strong domain knowledge, experimental design, statistical reasoning, data governance and the ability to explain uncertainty will remain useful as automated analytics and AI tools become more capable.
